DARV.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KNOW: Look around... all old stuff. But there is always something you need.
[i][font_size=22]The Knowledge Demon observes its surroundings with interest.[/font_size][/i]
You can't eat books for dinner, can you? Look at something else in the collection!
Heh. This book records thousands of years of history. You're bound to find it interesting.
Chronicles are fine. But the truly valuable part is often what was removed.
You don't want it? Then I'll put it back, I suppose.
[b]No![/b] I mean, let me think a little longer...
NEOW.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KNOW: [sine]You? ...Why... have you... come... to the bottom... of the tower...?[/sine]
[sine]...The answers... you seek... are... at the top... of the tower...[/sine]
[sine]I... reshaped... your flesh... Go now... and kill the Architect[/sine]
In truth, this body is merely a vessel.
My mind is an immortal existence. You did not reshape me, only my shell.
NONUPEIPE.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER: What an unusual visitor! Want jewelry or clothes? Take whatever you like.
I don't need such worldly possessions.
When you face the Architect, you'll need those "worldly possessions".
Smell of a demon... heh. Even you need my blessing?
Normally, I don't allow bugs in my room. You're the first exception.
Don't lump my vessel and me together. I am the concept of knowledge itself.
OROBAS.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KN: A demon residing in the brain?! Terrifying! Don't control me!
Rest assured. Your brain has no value to me.
Demon! Demon! The brain-parasitizing demon is back!
Demon! Stop manipulating other people's minds! That's not okay!!
But if I do, wouldn't that mean you are also controlling my mind?
Oh! Then keep going! Wait? No! Wait?
PAEL.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KNOW: [thinky_dots]You have learned thousands of things. Why still crave more?[/thinky_dots]
Knowledge, once it stops growing, begins to rot.
I can't be satisfied... I need more, [b]more![/b][jitter][b]MORE![/b][/jitter]
[thinky_dots]Greedy demon... why can't you learn to be content?[/thinky_dots]
I'm wondering whether your dreams hold the knowledge I crave.
[thinky_dots]Heh, interesting. Then go ahead and try... zZZzz...[/thinky_dots]
[i][font_size=22]The Knowledge Demon watched the sleeping Pael for a long time, then left in frustration.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KNOW: I do not need a weapon. The knowledge I have amassed over the ages will become my greatest...
[b]And you call yourself a demon! Where are your fangs and claws?![/b]
[i][font_size=22]The Knowledge Demon and Tanx fought fiercely.[/font_size][/i]
[b]Good! Good! This weapon suits me well, take it![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER: [jitter][b]Aww[/b][/jitter], what a cute little bug. What are you doing here??
Oh! It can talk. This is the first time I've seen such a [jitter][b]rare[/b][/jitter] little bug.
Welcome, welcome, [jitter][b]little darling[/b][/jitter]! Come, have some snacks!
Oh, poor little bug. If you want me to [jitter][b]burn away[/b][/jitter] those annoying parasites, come find me anytime.
VAKUU.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARACTER_KNO: We are both demons. I am revered as divine, while you are trapped in the brain of a worm.
The shackles of flesh are so dull. Make a deal with me, and I will free your soul completely.
Since we're both demons, spare me the tricks. Demon deals are never good news.
Still, I accepted it for a greater goal.
[sine]Heeheehee![/sine] You know what? A demon who signs a contract with another demon is a first for you!
Show me what you can do, Knowledge Demon.
[i][font_size=22]The Knowledge Demon whispered inside Vaku's mind.[/font_size][/i]
[sine]Haha[/sine]... not bad. But I can do little tricks like that too.
Now I'll show you something truly interesting.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_CHARA: What are you doing here instead of guarding the gate in your nest?
Reply
I refuse to remain trapped here.
Continue
Only by destroying you and freeing the Tower will freedom truly be mine.
Continue
Then let me give you true [b]freedom[/b].
Both
Still not giving up? A bug that abandons its duty usually doesn't live long.
Anger
I am not the bug you call me![jitter] I am a supreme demon![/jitter]
Continue
To me, you and the creature parasitizing beneath you are no different.
Continue
You will be destroyed just like those bugs.
Both
Still want to challenge me? Go back obediently and I might spare your life.
Refuse
I will not accept that ending.
Both
